mapper.select: SELECT COMPANY_IDX, COMPANY_EMAIL, COMPANY_PASSWORD FROM company_users WHERE COMPANY_EMAIL = #{value} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMPANY_USERS ( COMPANY_EMAIL, COMPANY_PASSWORD, CREATE_AT, COMPANY_REGION, COMPANY_NAME, COMPANY_REGISTRATION, COMPANY_SIZE, COMPANY_PHONE ) VALUES ( #{companyEmail}, #{companyPassword}, SYSDATE(), #{companyRegion}, #{companyName}, #{companyRegistration}, #{companySize}, #{companyPhone} )
